description:
Get the complete onboarding flow for a product: every step in order with titles, notes on
what happens, observed transitions (button labels and where they lead), and which steps are
alternate branches. Includes the handoff reference id to use with buildHandoff.

Use this to study how a competitor structures their signup and onboarding, what information
they collect at each step, and how they guide users to activation.

productId.description: Product id from listProducts, e.g. linear, stripe or airbnb.

name: get_flow

handoffId.description: Use with buildHandoff to get the full prompt.

scope.description:
What was captured. marketing: logged-out marketing pages only. public-demo: logged out, but real
product surfaces or public demos were used. task-incomplete: signed in, but the journey stops before
its result. signed-in: signed in, and the journey reaches its result.

branch.description: True if this step is an alternate path

id.description: The screenshot's id. A step that shows a product or marketing screen uses that screen's id.

title: Get a product's onboarding flow
